transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start, could you tell me what's been bringing you in to see me today?
Um… mostly I just get pulled off track really easily. Like, I’ll be trying to finish a dashboard, and then a Slack ping or even a random song lyric or idea pops up, and I just… lose the thread.
Has this trouble staying focused been something you've noticed since childhood or your school years, or is it something that started more recently in your life?

Yeah… I think it’s been around since I was little. I remember teachers writing stuff like that I rushed through worksheets or didn’t follow directions all the way. And my parents would sit with me during homework because I’d kind of drift off or start doing something else before finishing.
Besides losing focus, do you also notice things like feeling restless, fidgety, or acting impulsively—for example, interrupting others or blurting things out?

Yeah… sometimes. In group work, like when people are brainstorming, I’ll kind of jump in with my idea before they’re done explaining. Or I’ll start adding something to the Figma board too soon. I don’t mean to be pushy, I just get excited, but afterward I can tell it probably came off that way.
Do you notice these focus and impulsivity issues happening not just at work, but also in other areas of your life—like at home, in relationships, or in social settings?

Yeah… it’s not just work. It’s kind of shown up with freelance stuff and projects too. I’ve lost a couple small contracts because I didn’t follow through cleanly, and I missed a portfolio competition deadline… or didn’t get it together enough.

And socially, I think some friends or collaborators are a little hesitant to work with me now, even if they like my ideas. That’s… been hard to admit.

final_diagnosis.reason: Patient reports a lifelong pattern (since childhood, documented by teachers and parents) of inattentive symptoms (losing focus, distractibility, incomplete tasks) alongside impulsive/hyperactive symptoms (interrupting, jumping in prematurely), present across multiple settings (school, work, freelance projects, social relationships) causing functional impairment (lost contracts, missed deadlines, strained collaborations).
